name: The Nightmare Upstairs: What Happened to Ty and Bryn?
original_name: The Nightmare Upstairs: What Happened to Ty and Bryn?
overview: When allegations of abuse irrevocably fracture a Utah family, a bitter custody battle ensues. After the court orders the children into a controversial reunification program, Ty and Bryn take matters into their own hands by barricading themselves in a bedroom for 54 days, livestreaming their protest, and turning an intimate family crisis into a national viral reckoning.
